scope: One stochastic trial per condition; three synthetic role tasks, at most six completed decisions per role. Not a complete product benchmark, generalization result or release acceptance.

assessment.source-conditions: Baseline delivered a core answer within scope; candidate did not. Candidate used search_sources but hit a parameter-limit error, then continued searching/reading. Faster partial work is not a speedup.
assessment.source-valid: Baseline incomplete within observed scope; candidate retained 0-35 degree and quarterly-maintenance conditions, but added demands for a separate exhaustive requirements list. Completion is not unqualified semantic acceptance. No seventh baseline turn was observed.
assessment.revise-outcome: Both corrected summary, table and outcome-dependent recommendation while preserving valid registrations, event count and costs. Both reasonably collapsed duplicate procedural lines; exact preservation of every copy was not required. Candidate used read_manuscript but chose full draft_report, not revise_report. Five calls and 24.8s versus four calls and 12.9s did not improve efficiency.
assessment.overall: No demonstrated overall efficiency improvement. Both original jobs remain failed because a different source case was incomplete. Do not present lower aggregate tokens or tool availability as better end-to-end research. No labels changed and no paid rerun to obtain a green result.

post_trial_fix: Expose source-search maxItems/maxLength and enforce them with explicit argument paths. One new offline test; original paid artifacts remain unchanged. This post-trial fix has no new live-model result.
